## Code.svelte

### `interface Props`
- `copyButtonProps` :: Props forwarded to the copy button.

- `code` :: The source to display.
- `lang` :: The language used to highlight the source.
- `filename` :: An optional file name shown in the toolbar.
- `showLineNumbers` :: Draws a gutter of line numbers.
- `highlightLines` :: 1-based line numbers to mark, or a string such as "3-5,8".
- `wrap` :: Soft-wraps long lines instead of scrolling horizontally.
- `maxHeight` :: Caps the height and scrolls the rest: a ladder word (`lg`) or any CSS length (`24rem`).
- `form` :: `block` is a highlighted panel with a copy button; `inline` is a short snippet in running text.
- `textSize` :: The scale of the code, and of the file name in the toolbar.
- `textColor` :: The ink of the file name in the toolbar.
- `shape` :: The corner treatment of the panel, inline and block alike.
- `surface` :: The plate the code sits on: fill, border, rim and shadow together. @default 'paneled'
- `pad` :: The inset around an inline snippet. @default 'pad-xs'
